title: Unbiased Alignment for Large Language Models with Noisy Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2607.03248v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The alignment of large language models with human preferences is commonly achieved through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback or Direct Preference Optimization. However, these methods are vulnerable to the significant noise prevalent in real-world preference datasets. To address this critical issue, we present a theoretical framework for unbiased alignment, introducing the Unbiased Reward Model (URM) loss and the Unbiased Direct Preference Optimization (UDPO) loss. By mathematically correcting the distortion induced by preference noise, our novel objectives enable unbiased model training directly from noisy datasets, without requiring clean ground-truth supervision. We provide rigorous theoretical analyses demonstrating that our methods are noise-tolerant, parameter downward compatible, and classification-calibrated. translated_title: 面向含噪偏好的大语言模型无偏对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型与人类偏好的对齐通常通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）或直接偏好优化（DPO）来实现。然而，这些方法容易受到现实世界偏好数据集中普遍存在的显著噪声的影响。为了解决这一关键问题，我们提出了一个无偏对齐的理论框架，引入了无偏奖励模型（URM）损失和无偏直接偏好优化（UDPO）损失。通过对偏好噪声引起的失真进行数学修正，我们的新目标函数能够直接从含噪数据集中进行无偏的模型训练，而无需干净的真实标注监督。我们提供了严格的理论分析，证明我们的方法具有噪声容忍性、参数向下兼容性和分类校准性。在多个数据集上的全面实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的（方法，原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出无偏奖励模型（URM）损失与无偏直接偏好优化（UDPO）损失，通过数学修正偏好噪声造成的失真，使大语言模型无需干净标注即可直接从含噪偏好数据中实现无偏对齐。
en_tdlr: Proposes Unbiased Reward Model (URM) loss and Unbiased Direct Preference Optimization (UDPO) loss that mathematically correct the distortion caused by preference noise, enabling unbiased LLM alignment directly from noisy preference datasets without clean ground-truth supervision.
